ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups for other training crawlers (CCBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, etc.)
ideas.why: Config says block training crawlers but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the stated policy isn't enforced.

ideas.why: They are already allowed via the * group, so explicit groups only add future-proofing and documentation.
